title: Voice check-in outcome mapping
description: Output of /api/checkin. Maps what the patient said in a short voice check-in onto the open commitments from their last visit.

outcomes.description: One entry per open commitment discussed. Commitments not raised in the check-in get status "unknown".

patient_words.description: Quoted or closely paraphrased. "" if the commitment was not discussed.

unprompted_reports.description: Symptoms, side effects, or events the patient reported that were not tied to a commitment.

questions_for_doctor.description: Things the patient said they want to ask at the next visit. Carried into the brief.
